tagline: Toolbox midrange with a hidden boost on every swing

featuredCards.title: Gromnir
featuredCards.caption: The one big swing. A 6 that is never only a 6 — STORMCHANNEL slides a boost under it face down before anyone sees the number.

featuredCards.title: Storm's Toll
featuredCards.caption: A 2 on the table with two boosts hiding beneath it. Defend it honestly and the storm answers anyway.

featuredCards.title: The Hammer Answers
featuredCards.caption: Pulls Gromnir out of the deck or the discard pile, so the finisher is a plan you make, not a card you wait for.

featuredCards.title: Howling Gale
featuredCards.caption: Moves every fighter on the board — yours and theirs — to reset the fight where the hammer wants it.
